roleContracts.checkpointHandoff: exact visual manifest and digest after the current natural checkpoint

roleContracts.handoff: source-freeze-manifest exact ref and digest only

coordinationRules: No existing session is adopted, reassigned, or overlaid with a new role.
Every participant reads the shared baseline and retains only its pre-existing write boundary.
A mismatch creates hold/reassess at the next natural checkpoint; it does not create new work implicitly.
Mutable assignment, acknowledgement, and terminal handles remain in .collab/memory.
External candidate and validation artifacts remain in place and are connected only by exact ref and digest.
Runtime activation receipts are not artifact activation or acceptance records.
protectedHolds: source-analysis contribution remains candidate pending independent acceptance
no manuscript writer, PDF editor, publisher, or settlement owner activated
invalidation: baseline root changes without an owner-specific digest handoff
role, write boundary, source revision, or artifact ref changes
a pending independent report or visual manifest materializes
